CHAPTER ONE
Purpose and Basis
Purpose:
Article 1 - (1) The purpose of this Regulation is to determine the Principles of Undergraduate
Education to be applied to students who transfer vertically to Gebze Technical University based on
the Central Vertical Transfer Examination (DGS) conducted by OSYM.
Basis
Article 2 - (1) This regulation has been prepared based on Article 9 of the Regulation on the
Continuation of Undergraduate Education of Vocational Schools and Open Education Associate
Degree Program Graduates, published in the Official Gazette dated 29.07.2011 and n umbered
28009 by the Council of Higher Education.
CHAPTER TWO
Principles and Operation
Article 3 - (1) Students enrolled through vertical transfer are first admitted to the English
Exemption Exam. Those who pass the exemption exam are admitted to the undergraduate program.
Unsuccessful students, however, are required to attend the English Preparatory Class for one year.
After completing the preparatory class, if they succeed in the English Exemption Exam, they can
start their undergraduate studies; if they fail, they are given another opportunity to pass the exam
after one year. During this period, students cannot attend classes. They can only take the
undergraduate English proficiency exams. At the end of this period, if students still cannot succeed,
their relationship with the university is terminated. Students who fail in either the first or second
year, if they wish, can apply to the Student Selection and Placement Center to be placed in
universities where English instruction is not mandatory, in accordance with the twelfth paragraph
of Article 7 of the Regulation on the Principles to be Followed in Foreign Language Education and
Instruction with Foreign Language in Higher Education Institutions published in the Official
Gazette dated 4/12/2008 and numbered 27074.
(2) Students who have the right to start undergraduate education and training are granted exemption
based on the evaluation of the relevant Exemption and Equivalency Committees and the decision
of the relevant Department Management Boards for courses deemed e quivalent to those taken
during their associate degree education. (Amendment: Decision of the University Senate dated
28.12.2016 and numbered 2016/12-02)

Examinations and Evaluation
Article 4. (1) Examinations and evaluation, semester -end grades, and objections to exam results
are conducted in accordance with the relevant articles of the "GTU Undergraduate Education and
Training Regulation."
CHAPTER THREE
Miscellaneous and Final Provisions
Repealed Legislation
Article 5. (1) The GTU Vertical Transfer License implementation directive and its amendments,
which entered into force with the decision of the University Senate dated 13.06.2007 and numbered
2007/09, have been repealed by this directive.
Validity
Article 6. (1) This Directive entered into force with the decision of the Gebze Technical University
Senate dated 08.09.2011 and numbered 2011/23.
Execution
Article 7. (1) The provisions of this directive shall be executed by the Rector of Gebze Technical
University.
